entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I sat in my office, waiting to plac..."
entries.dialogueText: I sat in my office, waiting to place the call that would change the future of Rizia and Pales.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I placed the phone to my ear. I too..."
entries.dialogueText: I placed the phone to my ear. I took a deep breath as the Palesian palace operators connected me to Duke Reinhart.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Oh... Your Majesty. I've been wait..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh... Your Majesty. I've been waiting to hear from you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duke Reinhart. What a pleasure it..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Reinhart. What a pleasure it is to have the chance to speak with you again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is the King speaking.""
entries.dialogueText: "This is the King speaking."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hello, Axel.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hello, Axel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's King Romus Toras. The Ruler o..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's King Romus Toras. The Ruler of Rizia Imperii, and Valenqiris, and of Brenas and Iza; of Cardesse and Montaklar, and the ancient lands of the Rezenids, Descendant of the Most Honorable Queen Lyza and King Valero, and the Sovereign of the Kingdom of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I didn't expect to have a dialogue..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't expect to have a dialogue with you after what happened."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I'm afraid I don't see it that way..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid I don't see it that way, Your Majesty. Especially after what happened."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Am I supposed to be impressed?""
entries.dialogueText: "Am I supposed to be impressed?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed. You should be.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. You should be."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is just part of the protocol, a..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is just part of the protocol, as you know."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well... It doesn't really matter,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well... It doesn't really matter, Your Grace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Me too, Your Grace. And now, you'r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Me too, Your Grace. And now, you're going to hear me out."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. Because I wanted to talk to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. Because I wanted to talk to you about something."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm afraid I'm not bringing good n..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid I'm not bringing good news, Your Grace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Given the circumstances, I never t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given the circumstances, I never thought I would be giving you a personal phone call. But here we are."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Me neither. So listen carefully.""
entries.dialogueText: "Me neither. So listen carefully."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well... I'm not bringing good news..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well... I'm not bringing good news, Your Grace."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I wasn't expecting anything less.""
entries.dialogueText: "I wasn't expecting anything less."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I'm listening.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm listening."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I'm listening.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm listening."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""So... What did you want to tell me..."
entries.dialogueText: "So... What did you want to tell me, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Even after Pales' horrific actions..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even after Pales' horrific actions, I am showing you my respect by opening communications. Let that be clear."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please listen to me very carefully..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please listen to me very carefully. This is your last chance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am giving you a gentlemanly head..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am giving you a gentlemanly head start by informing you of my decision to invade Pales, Your Grace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wanted to offer you a way out. S..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wanted to offer you a way out. Surrender the duchy and swear fealty to the Rizian crown, so we can be stronger together."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Hah... You can't be serious.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hah... You can't be serious."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""No... You can't be serious.""
entries.dialogueText: "No... You can't be serious."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a brief silence."
entries.dialogueText: There was a brief silence.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There are no jokes, Your Grace. Pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are no jokes, Your Grace. Pales has become a rogue nation with you at its head. Rizia will militarily intervene -- if you don't comply."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The quicker you grasp the reality..."
entries.dialogueText: "The quicker you grasp the reality of the situation the better, Your Grace. I'm announcing the invasion of Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But I am. So listen to me very car..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I am. So listen to me very carefully."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He went silent."
entries.dialogueText: He went silent.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is not a joke, Your Grace. Pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is not a joke, Your Grace. Pales has become a rogue nation with you at its head. Rizia will militarily intervene -- if you don't comply."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""What?""
entries.dialogueText: "What?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sure I don't need to remind yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure I don't need to remind you of how much stronger the Rizian Armed Forces are compared to Pales' armies..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sure I don't need to remind yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure I don't need to remind you of how much larger Rizia is than Pales..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am aware of your intentions to l..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am aware of your intentions to let the western powers settle in our region in exchange for your own security. I will not allow that."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""What are you talking about?""
entries.dialogueText: "What are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""And?""
entries.dialogueText: "And?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm offering a peaceful way out fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm offering a peaceful way out from your dire situation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I cannot allow you to become a thr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot allow you to become a threat to our energy industry. You must understand my situation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I only want you to swear allegianc..."
entries.dialogueText: "I only want you to swear allegiance to the Rizian crown and reunite Pales with Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will surrender the Aureus fiel..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will surrender the Aureus field to Rizia completely."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will surrender all the territo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will surrender all the territories except the city of Pales to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The quicker you grasp the reality..."
entries.dialogueText: "The quicker you grasp the reality of the situation the better, Your Grace. I'm announcing the invasion of Pales."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""You must be insane if you think I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must be insane if you think I'll give in to your threats."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Pales stood against the forces of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales stood against the forces of your father, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""If you insist on repeating his mis..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you insist on repeating his mistakes, we will stand against you as well."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""We can't lead our countries to war..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't lead our countries to war. Peace must be maintained by any means necessary."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's too late for that.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's too late for that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you want peace... Listen to me..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you want peace... Listen to me very carefully."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Think of your people, Axel. Think..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think of your people, Axel. Think of the destruction your people will suffer. Surrender before it's too late."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are right. I am insane. But I..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are right. I am insane. But I thought you were cleverer than that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You still dare insult me? You will..."
entries.dialogueText: "You still dare insult me? You will pay for this, Duke Reinhart."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's it, then. It's war.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's it, then. It's war."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Remember: I gave you a choice, and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember: I gave you a choice, and you refused. You will regret it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This time it will be very differen..."
entries.dialogueText: "This time it will be very different."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am sorry it had to come to this,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry it had to come to this, Axel. I hope you'll survive the war."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have a good day, Axel.""
entries.dialogueText: "Have a good day, Axel."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I hung up."
entries.dialogueText: I hung up.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And just like that, the Second Pale..."
entries.dialogueText: And just like that, the Second Pales War had begun.
